environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. WebACL includes rule group reference statement with vendorName 'AWS' and name 'AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet' at priority 1 with override action none (default BLOCK). Additionally, a secondary rule group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' at priority 2 with SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only. The SQLi rule set uses sensitivity level HIGH which inspects QUERY_STRING, BODY, URI_PATH, and SINGLE_HEADER 'cookie'. CloudWatch metrics enabled with sampled requests. Note: the CommonRuleSet SizeRestriction is in COUNT mode and does NOT block oversized query strings - it only logs them. The ALB forwards X-Forwarded-For but does not modify query parameters.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener on 443, target group to port 8080
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15.4, same VPC private subnet
config.network: ALB in public subnet, ECS tasks in private subnet
config.notes: WAF metrics show ~2% false positive rate on legitimate product searches containing apostrophes in brand names
